kata.name: Observer weak lens: stale delivery on a two-subject/three-observer model — the coherence equation finds it, the conventional test finds it too
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: Observer has no proven equivalence in ploeh §6; the weak coherence lens is expected to buy zero unique detections (parity)

expected.detail: the weak lens is the equation subject∘event = seen; the seeded fault makes Observer row 1 deliver e2 while its subject s1 currently holds e1. The scripted conventional test checks the same payload coherence for every registered observer, so the detection is parity, not unique.

commands: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: scripted conventional test matches the pre-registered detections
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/observer-fault-stale-delivery.ct.json --json  # exit 3, 1 findings
cargo test -p catherine-ledger --test weak_lens_set_kata  # frozen evidence test

comparison.conventional_baseline: scripted Observer test: for every observer, delivered event = event(subject(observer)); covers all three observer rows

expressibility_gap.invariant: notification totality over dynamically registered observers
expressibility_gap.why: the model names the observer rows and subject edges up front, so observers registered after the model is written cannot be checked

discrepancies: ploeh-grounding.md §6 lists these patterns as HYPOTHESIZED candidates, not proven equivalences; this slice records parity or a null result and does not upgrade any of them.
procedure: 1. control first: validate the near-floor control's empty unique set and killed verdict before any positive is read.
2. probe arm: cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check <fixture> --json; findings recorded verbatim.
3. baseline arm: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert; detections are the pre-registered element names.
4. unique = probe elements - baseline elements; the element vocabulary is fixed in fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/README.md.
5. verdict: empty unique with an expressible lens => killed (parity); an unexpressible lens with zero findings => killed with the gap recorded (null result).
